alt: Official California DHCS notification letter confirming Nicolas Hernandez is enrolled in L.A. Care Health Plan, effective April 1, 2025.
summary: This official notification letter from the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) confirms the successful welcome and enrollment of Nicolas Hernandez into L.A. Care Health Plan, effective April 1, 2025. This document serves as primary evidence of the plan transition timeline, establishing the exact date upon which L.A. Care became the active managed care plan responsible for coordinating the claimant's health services. In the context of the audit, this record is critical for establishing L.A. Care's regulatory oversight, network adequacy obligations, and direct liability for administrative default and Conlan reimbursement claims starting on April 1, 2025.
